intro.text: Tuaka'li'na'calmi'nor, called Tuaka or simply Song, is Lunamor's wife, a round-faced Horneater woman who wears her deep red hair in a braid.

items.text: Tuaka and Lunamor have known each other since childhood in the Horneater Peaks, where, by his account, she built the best snow forts. They married and had six children before he left for Alethkar. After he won his freedom, he wrote asking her to bring the family to the Shattered Plains.

After months of travel, Tuaka reached the Shattered Plains with her family. Voidbringers attacked their caravan, and the family held out behind a pile of furniture until Bridge Four found them on patrol and brought them to Urithiru, where Kaladin gave them his rooms.

Reunited with Lunamor, she was surprised to find him a cook and all his brothers dead, but he asked her not to press him. She brought news of troubles in the Peaks that she would only discuss in private.
Soon after the people of Hearthstone were evacuated, Tuaka went back to the Peaks with most of the family, leaving Cord and Gift behind.
